history.prompt: matte clay 3D render, soft-body shapes, studio render with a neutral seamless backdrop. Three or four simplified geometric forms arranged in a clear physical stack, with one distinct, contrasting block firmly wedged into the center of the structure. Single soft key light with gentle contact shadows, matte muted palette of soft gray and a single accent color, clean minimalist arrangement.

style_when: the article explains how a system, process or stack actually works — money flows, supply chains, pipelines, an agent assembly line
prompt: Clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. A modular server blade assembly featuring an integrated mechanical metering valve and flow sensor attached directly to the main processing housing. Flat muted palette with one bright accent colour highlighting the metering component, thin consistent line weight. Recognisable hardware with racks, trays, and conduit pipes showing visible depth. Unlabelled, generous empty margin.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, abstract boxes, bare geometry, cubes, spheres, logos, watermarks, people, glowing brains
rationale: The story focuses on embedding cost control and usage tracking directly into the architecture of AI purchases. A technical isometric cutaway effectively illustrates this integration by showing a recognisable engineered module with an integrated metering mechanism.
subject: an isometric cutaway of a modular server blade with an integrated metering valve and sensor
alt_text: Isometric cutaway of a modular server blade featuring an integrated metering valve and flow sensor.
caption: As AI spending surges, buyers are demanding that cost management and usage tracking be engineered directly into the underlying architecture.
title: AI FinOps Metering Isometric
